spacePicker.allScope: If none is selected, all spaces are included.

glossary.metric: Metric: a kind of value a device sends (e.g. temperature, co2). It has a key, unit and valid range.
glossary.quality: Quality code: 0 normal, 1 out of range, 2 unverified metric, 3 suspect (stuck or jumping value), 4 time corrected, 5 forecast
glossary.deviceStatus: Device status: PENDING awaiting approval, ACTIVE in use, INACTIVE disabled (data is stored but excluded from rules and analytics)
glossary.connectivity: Connectivity: ONLINE received within the expected interval, OFFLINE nothing received for interval × multiplier, UNKNOWN not yet determined
glossary.lifecycle: Source state: DRAFT draft, ACTIVE collecting, PAUSED paused (session kept), ARCHIVED archived
glossary.runtimeState: Connection: CONNECTED, CONNECTING, DISCONNECTED, ERROR (fails even after retries), DISABLED
glossary.comfort: Comfort: current values against the space's target environment. Normal, caution (within 10% outside the target), warning
